text:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm coordinating the GPS handoff for release v1.3.2 in the 02:00 PT change window. Need API/runtime/console/router on-call to be available for the sequence. :eyes:

alex: Canary plan details? Need percentages, durations, and explicit shard ordering.

maya: Plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% if metrics clean. Router pinned to 1.3.2-rc3, runtime pinned to 1.3.2, API to v1.3.2. Console deploy will be feature-flagged (no pin). Important: drain eviction queue on shards A then B before moving to 25%.

simon: Copy. I'll run staging smoke and preflight. Command: `/deploybot preflight --service=router --release=1.3.2 --shard=A`

deploybot: preflight accepted — router preflight job queued for shard A. Report: https://ci.example/reports/7210004321-preflight (job 4521).

casey: Note: console adds a nullable schema field; QA signed off but rollback needs ordering. Rollback path: revert router pin, then runtime, then api. Console schema revert is separate and will follow after core services stable. Hotfix branch ready.

alex: Agreed rollback triggers: sustained 5xx > 1% for 3m OR p95 latency on api->runtime path up > 300ms vs baseline. Rollback order: router -> runtime -> api. We'll keep the canary at 5% for at least 10m and only escalate if health == green.

maya: I'll toggle canary after shard A drain completes and preflight passes. Draft release-note blurb: 

---
Release v1.3.2
- Router: pinned 1.3.2-rc3
- Runtime: pinned 1.3.2
- API: v1.3.2
- Console: feature-flag rollout (no pin)
- Canary: 5% (10m) -> 25% (10m) -> 100%
- Eviction drain: shards A then B required before 25% step
- Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR p95 latency +300ms over baseline
- Rollback order: router -> runtime -> api
---

simon: :thumbsup: Starting shard A drain now, will update when A->B handoff done. Running `kubectl drain --force` on router pods for shard A, watching eviction queue.

ops-bot: Deploy window open 02:00-03:30 PT. Oncall pager: @oncall-eng. Keep this thread pinned and report post-deploy anomalies here. :bell:

casey: Also, note metrics dashboards: apigw -> runtime latency panel and router errors. If we see cross-service spike, do not escalate to full 100% — pause at 25% and roll back to previous stable pins.

alex: I'll monitor the synthetic traffic and set alert for 5xx spike. Simon, call out when preflight report is green.

simon: Preflight report: green. Smoke tests: gen-requests OK, kv-cache sanity OK. Moving to canary 5%.

deploybot: canary started: 5% traffic to v1.3.2 (router 1.3.2-rc3). Canary timer: 10m. Link: https://deploys.example/7210004321-canary

maya: Kicking off canary now. Watching dashboards.

(10m passes)

alex: No elevated 5xx, p95 delta within 50ms. Good to move to 25% once shard B drain completes.

simon: Shard A->B handoff complete, starting drain on shard B. ETA ~4m.

ops-bot: Reminder: if we hit rollback criteria, use `/deploybot rollback --release=1.3.2 --services=router,runtime,api --order=router,runtime,api`

casey: If rollback invoked, teams should hold feature-flag changes on console until core services stable.

maya: Shard B drained. Proceeding to 25% step.

deploybot: traffic increased to 25% (router pinned 1.3.2-rc3, runtime 1.3.2). Canary timer: 10m. Link: https://deploys.example/7210004321-canary-step2

alex: Monitoring. If anything degrades, ops will trigger rollback and run the ordered revert.

(10m passes)

alex: p95 increase observed on api->runtime path +320ms sustained 4m and 5xx at 1.4% for 5m. Rolling back now per criteria.

maya: Triggering rollback: starting with router pin revert.

deploybot: rollback initiated. Reverting router pin to previous stable. Rolling change across shards.

simon: Noted. Pausing runtime and api rollbacks until router revert stabilizes.

(rolling revert complete)

deploybot: router revert complete. Monitoring traffic.

alex: Router revert brought 5xx down to baseline, p95 back within 80ms of baseline after 2m. Good. Pausing further rollbacks.

casey: We'll leave console feature-flag off until tomorrow morning to avoid schema edge cases. Create a follow-up ticket to re-run canary with additional synthetic coverage for the runtime path.

maya: Filing follow-up: https://issues.example/RED-1234 (add synthetic test + re-run canary).

ops-bot: Deploy window still open but rollout halted. Closing thread when all follow-ups tracked.
